notes.title: Pilo Version 1.2 Now Available – Major Fixes and Quality Improvements
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120027/66c6142296f6ec5b686bd546a83fb280c689a3f2.png"]
Pilo and the Holobook Updated to Version 1.2 – Now Live on Steam and Nintendo Switch!
A fresh update just dropped for Pilo and the Holobook on Steam and Nintendo Switch! Version 1.2 brings several improvements based on player feedback:

Fixed collision issues on the Broken planet and in the Workshop – no more falling into the void!

Players starting the full game after trying the demo will now begin a new save to avoid critical errors.

A new “Nomad” sticker has been added at the end of a specific quest, making it easier to complete for 100%!

This patch makes the experience smoother and more player-friendly – jump back in and see what’s new in the world of Pilo!



[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//44120027/0f1c47f6414b4710aeee6a1d734f4dd48bafc864.gif"]

notes.title: New Demo Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
Hello space explorers!

For those of you who have played the previous version of Pilo and the Holobook’s demo, a bit more adventure awaits you in this new Steam Next Fest version!

Here’s what changed from the previous version:

 One of the planets from the full game is now included. It's a desert planet in which you'll have to solve several puzzles, adding around half an hour of gameplay to the demo. That’s plenty of new stickers, dialogues, and visuals for ya!
 New music, new sounds - they’re quite sandy!
 Polished art, fixed bugs 🐜
 Following feedback from the community, Pilo is now faster 🏃‍♂️💨


Have fun playing the new version of the demo and see you soon, space explorers 🚀
